# TRL-EMIT-0008: Secret reference emitted; the secret must exist on the target

- Severity: info
- Exit class: none
- Area: EMIT
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Create the secret named in `params.secret` before enabling the workflow; no value was read or written.
